name: selected_route_id
description: The unique identifier for the SelectedRoute resource. It corresponds to the final component of the resource name: 'projects/{project}/selectedRoutes/{selected_route_id}'. Constraints: Length must be between 4 and 63 characters. Pattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$' (alphanumeric and hyphens only). Strict rejection of underscores or special symbols. Serving as the primary correlation key across RMI telemetry datasets. Acts as a logical primary key (must not be NULL, though physically NULLABLE in the schema). Use this ID to join with historical_travel_time and routes_status tables.

name: display_name
description: User-provided descriptive name for the route. Intended for human readability in reports and UIs. No uniqueness constraint. Max length 128 characters.

name: record_time
description: The UTC timestamp representing when the near real-time route data was computed. Unlike the hourly-truncated historical table, this table contains high-frequency updates (typically every 2 minutes) with a rolling 60-day retention period. Highly recommended to always filter on record_time in WHERE clauses to restrict scan costs and optimize performance.

name: duration_in_seconds
description: The near real-time traffic-aware duration of the route in seconds, estimating travel time considering current real-time traffic conditions at 'record_time'. Bounded >= 0. Omitted (NULL) when has_road_closure is true because the route is impassable.

name: static_duration_in_seconds
description: The traffic-unaware (static) duration of the route in seconds, representing estimated travel time under ideal or free-flow conditions, regardless of current traffic. Always >= 0.

name: route_geometry
description: The traffic-aware polyline geometry of the route as a GEOGRAPHY object (EPSG:4326), representing the actual optimal path determined by the routing engine at 'record_time'.

name: road_segment_ids
description: Place IDs along the route in topological order indicating connected road segments.

name: speed_reading_intervals
description: Legacy coordinate-based speed reading intervals. May stop being populated on or after January 13, 2027. Use speed_reading_offsets instead. To query these fields in SQL, use 'LEFT JOIN UNNEST(speed_reading_intervals)' to avoid discarding rows if the array is empty.

fields.name: interval_coordinates
fields.description: Legacy. May stop being populated on or after January 13, 2027. Use speed_reading_offsets instead. The geometry for this interval as an array of GEOGRAPHY coordinates. EPSG:4326 projection.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Legacy. May stop being populated on or after January 13, 2027. Use speed_reading_offsets instead. The classification of the speed for this interval. Possible values: 'NORMAL', 'SLOW', 'TRAFFIC_JAM'. In this legacy field, heavy traffic jams (dark red) are also reported as 'TRAFFIC_JAM'; 'TRAFFIC_JAM_HEAVY' is never used.

name: speed_reading_offsets
description: Offset-based speed reading intervals representing traffic density across the route; each interval is demarcated by the distance offset from the start of the route in meters. Available as of October 8, 2026. Omitted when has_road_closure is true.

fields.name: start_offset
fields.description: The distance offset from the start of the route in meters for the start of the interval (inclusive).

fields.name: end_offset
fields.description: The distance offset from the start of the route in meters for the end of the interval (exclusive; equals the start_offset of the subsequent interval).

fields.name: speed
fields.description: The classification of the speed for this interval, aligned with the colors in the Google Maps traffic layer. Possible values: 'NORMAL' (green), 'SLOW' (yellow), 'TRAFFIC_JAM' (red), 'TRAFFIC_JAM_HEAVY' (dark red, available as of October 8, 2026).

name: has_road_closure
description: Whether there is a full road closure on the route. When true, duration_in_seconds and speed_reading_offsets are omitted because the route is impassable. A NULL value indicates that road closure information is undetermined. Consistent with Google Maps full road closure status.
